noBase: not enough history for a baseline
unavailable: Not available: 5/15/30 min blocks need a range of 10 days or less.
tooMany: Too many blocks for this range.
biggerThanRange: The block is larger than the range.
editOverviewHelp: Lists any device (even if not in the chart) that has been unusually active in the last two hours, and shows a red counter. Nothing is shown while all devices are normal.
editDevicesHelp: Up to 12. Leave empty to show the three busiest.
editInvalid: That block size is not available for this range; the card will use a larger one.
cardDescription: Per-device DNS activity with unusual-activity detection
cardLiveDescription: Live pulse of one device: rate, usual range, allowed and blocked queries
editAnimateHelp: Move the gauge and the ring smoothly. Off by default.
editDeviceHelp: Pick the device. This is its DNS queries counter; the card finds the rest by itself.
editTitleHelp: Optional. Leave empty to use the device name.
editShowTitleHelp: The device name, or your title, at the top of the card.
editShowBadgeHelp: Shows Normal, or Unusual activity with how many times the usual rate.
editShowGaugeHelp: Queries per minute right now, with the alert threshold and, when known, the usual rate.
editShowRingHelp: The ring around the gauge with the share of allowed, blocked and provisional queries.
editShowLegendHelp: The totals of allowed, blocked and provisional queries.
editShowStripHelp: One bar per second for the last minute, as queries arrive.
editShowStatusHelp: A coloured dot and the time since the last query. Amber or red when the data may be stale or incomplete.
